**Minecraft 26.2 and 26.3 servers can be inspected: the agent works on them, and `session_start` no longer fails because bots cannot join.**

Nothing breaks against 3.2.0. The tools and their arguments are unchanged, and the server plugin is the same as 3.2.0's apart from its version number. Two answers change shape: `session_start` gains a `bots` object, and its `minecraftProtocol` is `null` when bots cannot join.

### Added

**Agent-only sessions.** On a server bots cannot join, `session_start` used to fail outright and take logs, events and state down with it. It now opens the session for the agent tools, and `bots` in its response says why bots are unavailable. `bot_spawn`, `bot_inspect`, `bot_view` and `bot_run_scenario` refuse with that reason, and `session_reset` tries the runner again.

That is the state of 26.2 and 26.3 today. The agent was checked on Paper 26.2-134 and 26.3-200: it loads, captures events and logs, answers state queries and runs commands. Bots cannot join yet, because mineflayer and minecraft-protocol stop at 26.1. That is tracked in #4.

### Fixed

**Bots no longer join as 1.21.1 behind ViaBackwards.** The runner pings in 1.21's protocol, and ViaVersion with ViaBackwards answers a ping in the client's own protocol whenever it can translate. On such a server bots joined as 1.21.1, through a chain of translations and with no error. Bots now follow the Minecraft version the agent reports, and when the ping disagrees `session_start` says so in `bots.pingProtocol`.

The same change covers a proxy that echoes the ping request's protocol. `minecraftProtocol` no longer has to be passed behind one, and it stays available as an override.

A runner that refuses to start is now reported with its reason, without the line-protocol framing around it.

### Upgrading

Install as before; the server plugin can stay on 3.2.0. If you passed `minecraftProtocol` only because of a proxy, you can drop it. If you ran bots on 26.2 or 26.3 through ViaBackwards on purpose, pass `"minecraftProtocol": 775`. #4 explains what that translation does and does not show.

The 26.2 investigation in #3 by @jnelken is what this release builds on. Its probe is now part of the lifecycle test: `node test/lifecycle.live.mjs <host> <port> <bot> <protocol>`.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Backas03/VitaminMCP/compare/3.2.0...3.2.1
